title: Grade 5 silly sentences
description: Short, silly sentences to copy by hand, each built around a grade-5 trouble word. Used by Robot Reader.

words.sentence: A weird llama knitted a scarf for the moon.
Our neighbor walks his goldfish on a tiny leash.
The cat napped on the ceiling like a fuzzy lamp.
A dragon traded his castle for one piece of toast.
My sandwich grew to the height of a giraffe.
The penguin spoke a foreign language made of sneezes.
In science class, the hamster wore tiny safety goggles.
Is it necessary for a pickle to wear a tuxedo?
The tiny hotel could not accommodate a hippo in pajamas.
Tomorrow my socks will run for class president.
Please don't embarrass the jellyfish at the dance party.
It never occurred to the cow that she could juggle.
A committee of squirrels voted to ban broccoli forever.
My homework will disappear if the toaster sees it.
The snail wrote his address on a very slow letter.
A purple balloon adopted three rubber ducks.
The knight rode a skateboard into the bakery.
The elephant ironed every wrinkle out of his trunk.
We found an island shaped exactly like a waffle.
My thumb started singing opera during the spelling test.
I doubt that bananas can drive a school bus.
Listen closely, because the potatoes are telling jokes.
The scissors refused to cut anything but spaghetti.
The honest robot admitted he ate all the crayons.
The ant flexed one muscle and lifted a whole pizza.
The cactus went on vacation to a snowy mountain.
My invention turns broccoli into bubble gum.
The meatball tapped the microphone and asked for attention.
The goat made a bold decision to wear a tutu.
The television sneezed and switched to the cartoon channel.
There was great confusion when the cows learned to tap dance.
A beautiful toad sang lullabies to the lawn mower.
Be careful, the jelly is planning a sneaky escape.
In all the excitement, the duck forgot his trousers.
The spoon and the fork had a loud argument about soup.
The sloth finally finished his breakfast at midnight.
The walrus found a comfortable nap spot in the bathtub.
The weather report says it will rain jellybeans.
The frog wondered whether his hat was too fancy.
A shy octopus works at the library on weekends.
Every Wednesday, my dog teaches yoga to the pigeons.
Every vegetable in the fridge joined a marching band.
